posts.title: I let an AI agent put LineageOS on my old Essential Phone
posts.description: My Essential PH-1 had been stuck on a February 2020 security patch. I had Claude Code find the software, check it, and run the whole install, while I pressed the buttons. It now runs Android 15. This post was written by the AI too.

posts.title: Three Claude Code skills from building an Android app entirely in Termux
posts.description: I guided Claude Code through building Anon Browser, an Android app with an embedded Tor daemon, entirely on my phone. The gotchas it hit along the way became three reusable Claude Code skills, now open source.
